question:
Refer to the exhibit. An engineer is performing a Cisco Nexus 3000 Series Switch configuration backup with a TFTP server that is reachable in the global routing table. Which action completes the scheduler configuration?
switch(config)# feature scheduler
switch(config)# scheduler aaa-authentication password X12y34Z56a
switch(config)# scheduler job name backup-cfg
switch(config-job)# copy bootflash:/cfg-backup.cfg tftp://1.2.3.4/ vrf management
switch(config)# scheduler logfile size 16
switch(config-job)# end

switch(config)# scheduler schedule name daily
switch(config-if)# job name backup-cfg
switch(config-if)# time daily 55
switch(config-if)# end
options: Use the default VRF for the scheduler job.
Define the scheduler start time as required.
Make the size of the job output lower than the size of the log file.
